response.overview: In a world dominated by a powerful technological system, three young Christians, Shadrach, Meshak, and Abed, refuse to surrender their faith to a ruthless corporate leader enforcing mandatory microchip implants. Their defiance makes them targets of a dangerous regime, pushing their friendship, courage, and beliefs to the ultimate test. As persecution intensifies and hope fades, they must stand firm against overwhelming odds. Inspired by Daniel 3 & based on Revelation 13, TRIO is a Christian prophetic action thriller exploring unwavering faith, sacrifice, and divine deliverance.
response.tagline: When the world chooses to bow, three men choose to stand.
